title.narrative: PIMS 9517 ARG/D24/G63 - Integrated Management for Sustainable Reduction (IMSRed) of POPs and other Highly Hazardous Pesticides and industrial chemicals in Argentina

description.narrative: The objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the project concept into a full project: Integrated Management for Sustainable Reduction (IMSRed) of POPs, Highly Hazardous Pesticides, and industrial chemicals in Argentina. As described in the project concept (child project concept note), this project aims to minimize impact on global environment and on human health from POPs and other Hazardous chemicals, its waste releases and exposure, through an integrated approach of prevention, sound management, and elimination of critical wastes on key productive sectors as well as the development of innovative finance schemes for their replacement.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
